Current findings:
- Project compares llama.cpp-family engines pflash, buun, ik, mainline (PR #27342) on dual P100 16GB, Qwen3.8-27B quants, pp/tg with/without MTP, DFlash2.
- sm_60 constraints: no dp4a/tensor cores/async copy; FP16 2:1 rate; dequant to f16/cuBLAS good, integer quant paths poor.
- No NVLink, PCIe 3.0; NCCL AllReduce loses/fails.
- Engines: pflash, buun, ik, mainline. mainline added for DFlash2 PR open not merged. Split modes: none/layer/row usable for qwen35; tensor unusable; graph only ik. ik graph blocked by NCCL in current build.
- MTP flag syntax differs. DFlash2 only mainline, auto-detect v2 via selector_top_k. Drafters: MTP head, DFlash2 Q4/Q8. Speculative output-preserving.
- Models: Qwen3.8-27B quants; IQ3_S single-GPU only; Q6_K_M primary; Q4_K_XL for H2; stock noMTP for H3
